## Description

This dress does it all. Run errands, wear to work, and enjoy leisure days in this softly draped A-line fit dress, designed to be your everyday go-to.

**Features:**

• Soft handfeel

• Naturally breathable

• 4-way stretch fabric

• Fabrics sustainably sourced without harmful chemicals

**Material:**

• 92% Viscose 8% Elastane \| Insert : 95% Cotton 5% Elastane

**Care Instructions:**

• Do not bleach

• Hang to dry

• Iron at low temperature (110 °C)

• Machine wash on cold / delicate

• Do not iron print
